components.name: Active Navigation Pill
components.description: Active view switcher and dossier trigger pill in the top bar.
components.css: .ds-btn-pill-active { background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(15,23,42,0.94) 0%, rgba(30,41,59,0.90) 100%); color: #ffffff; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25); box-shadow: 0 8px 20px -4px rgba(15,23,42,0.18), inset 0 1px 1.5px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.35); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s ease, opacity 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-pill-active:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Forensic Telemetry Card
components.description: Refractive liquid-glass card displaying calibrated forensic metrics.
components.css: .ds-card-forensic { background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.92) 0%, rgba(248,250,252,0.80) 100%); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.96); border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px -6px rgba(15,23,42,0.05), inset 0 1px 1.5px 0 rgba(255,255,255,1); font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-card-label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #64748B; } .ds-card-value { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; color: #0F172A; margin-top: 4px; }

narrative.overview: Veritas Forensic blends clinical laboratory precision with specular liquid-glass optics. Designed for high-stakes academic integrity reviews, the interface pairs high-contrast slate typography and tabular monospace telemetry with translucent, multi-layered refractive panels.
keyCharacteristics: Specular liquid-glass surfaces over a cool daylight laboratory canvas (#F5F7FB).
Dual-font discipline: Plus Jakarta Sans for UI and manuscript prose paired with JetBrains Mono (tabular-nums) for forensic telemetry.
Strict four-tier semantic alert colors (Rose, Orange, Amber, Emerald).
Viewport-locked split-pane workbench where navigation and telemetry remain stationary while the manuscript scrolls independently.

rules.name: The Semantic Tier Exclusivity Rule
rules.body: Rose (#E11D48), Orange (#EA580C), Amber (#D97706), and Emerald (#059669) are reserved strictly for evidentiary forensic tiers and protection badges—never use them as decorative backgrounds.

rules.name: The Tabular Telemetry Rule
rules.body: Every numeric probability, log-odds weight, word count, and p-value must render in JetBrains Mono with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so columns never jitter during live sandbox adjustments.

rules.name: The Specular Rim Rule
rules.body: Every elevated glass panel pairs a soft outer slate shadow with a 1.5px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95) border and inset 0 1.5px 2px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 1) top highlight to preserve physical edge definition against light backgrounds.

dos: Do keep the outer shell locked to h-screen overflow-hidden so scrolling inside the manuscript never scrolls the top navigation bar or telemetry sidebar out of view.
Do render mathematical expressions through KaTeX (MathText) and display the LaTeX Math Guard badge whenever symbolic density is detected.
Do use JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums for all forensic metrics, p-values, and log-odds weights.
donts: Don't use dark-mode neon cyberpunk backgrounds; maintain the clinical daylight laboratory aesthetic (#F5F7FB).
Don't display a Tier 3 (Proven Synthetic) badge when deterministic container proof is absent.
Don't allow raw LaTeX control sequences or PDF font ligature garbage to render unformatted in the manuscript reader.
